吴姜静静体会了片刻鬼卒中期的强大，这才满意的起床，迈步走向隔壁房间，去看念念。

小丫头正抱着布娃娃，坐在床上，目不转睛地盯着电视，津津有味地看着动画片，小脑袋还跟着剧情轻轻一点一点，模样可爱极了。

吴姜走上前，轻轻弹了弹她的小脑袋，叮嘱道：“不许一直只顾着看动画片，也得好好修炼，不然下次再这样，就把电视给你关掉。”

小丫头立刻垮下小脸，嘟嘟囔囔地跟吴姜撒了好一会儿娇，见吴姜态度坚决，才不情不愿地嘟着小嘴，化作一道微光，钻回聚灵吊坠里修炼去了。

吴姜笑着摇了摇头，随后到厨房简单做了一点吃的。看来就算是突破了，肚子该饿还是饿。

吃饱喝足，吴姜打了个懒洋洋的哈欠，躺回床上，没多久便沉沉睡去。

次日清晨，吴姜被窗外的阳光叫醒，起身伸了个懒腰，浑身的筋骨都发出轻微的脆响，一股沛然的力量感再次席卷全身。

只是此次的任务奖励，却比预想中慢了不少。

直到晚上，识海中的阴差令牌忽然轻轻震动了一下，奖励终于下来了。

吴姜眼睛一亮，迫不及待的拿起令牌查看。

地府这次很大方，因为情报失误的原因，他们此次的任务属于越级战斗，按照贡献划分，这次的任务足足奖励了5000贡献点。

“居然有五千点！”吴姜忍不住低喝一声，脸上满是笑意。

他原本以为，这次任务能拿到一千多点贡献就不错了，没想到因为越级完成任务，还有额外加成，直接给到了五千点，这份惊喜，来得实在太突然。

他眼馋很久的一门术法，终于能兑换了。

镇魂定身印，由黑无常提供，兑换价格，正好5000点贡献。

这门术法，既能镇压凶煞鬼魂，也能瞬间定住鬼魂身形，限制其行动。

遥想当年看《西游记》，大圣的定身术，可是羡慕坏了无数小朋友。

当然，黑无常的这门镇魂定身印，只能说是和大圣的定身术有异曲同工之妙，但是威力嘛，差的也不多，也就大圣一个跟头的距离。

“就是它了！”吴姜没有丝毫犹豫，当即点击了兑换。

Wu Jiang quietly experienced the power of the Ghost Soldier Stage for a moment, and then he got up with satisfaction and walked to the next room to see Nian Nian.

The little girl was holding a rag doll, sitting on the bed, staring at the TV, watching cartoons with relish, her little head was tapping along with the plot, she looked so cute.

Wu Jiang stepped forward, flicked her little head, and warned: "Don't just watch cartoons all the time. You have to practice hard, or if you do this again next time, I will turn off the TV for you."

The little girl immediately dropped her face and cooed with Wu Jiang for a long time. Seeing Wu Jiang's resolute attitude, she reluctantly pouted her little mouth, turned into a gleam of light, and got back into the Ling Gathering Pendant to practice.

Wu Jiang smiled and shook his head, then went to the kitchen to make a simple meal.It seems that even if you have a breakthrough, you should still be hungry.

After eating and drinking enough, Wu Jiang yawned lazily, lay down on the bed, and fell asleep soon after.

The next morning, Wu Jiang was woken up by the sunshine outside the window. He stood up and stretched. His muscles and bones made a slight crunch, and a strong sense of strength swept through his body again.

However, the rewards for this mission were much slower than expected.

Until night, the Yin Cha Token in the Consciousness Sea suddenly vibrated slightly, and the reward finally came down.

Wu Jiang's eyes lit up and he couldn't wait to pick up the token and check it.

The underworld was very generous this time. Due to intelligence errors, their mission this time was a leapfrog battle. According to contribution, this mission rewarded a full 5,000 contribution points.

"There are actually five thousand points!" Wu Jiang couldn't help shouting, with a smile on his face.

He originally thought that it would be good to get more than a thousand contribution points for this mission. Unexpectedly, because of the extra bonus for completing the mission at a higher level, he was directly given five thousand points. This surprise came too suddenly.

A technique that he had been coveting for a long time could finally be redeemed.

The Soul-Calming Seal is provided by Hei Wuchang, and the exchange price is exactly 5,000 contribution points.

This technique can not only suppress the evil ghosts, but also instantly immobilize the ghosts and restrict their movements.

I recall the time when I watched "Journey to the West" and saw the great sage's body-fixing skills, which made countless children jealous.

Of course, Hei Wuchang's Soul-Soothing Immobilization Seal can only be said to be similar to the Great Sage's Immobilization Technique, but in terms of power, it is not much different, only a step away from the Great Sage.

"That's it!" Wu Jiang didn't hesitate at all and immediately clicked the redemption button.
